rows.label: FICTION
rows.clue: A literary work based on the imagination and not necessarily on fact

rows.label: ADAPTATION
rows.clue: A written work (as a novel) that has been recast in a new form

rows.label: DEBUGGER
rows.clue: A program that helps in locating and correcting programming errors

rows.label: CODICIL
rows.clue: A supplement to a will

rows.label: DANCE
rows.clue: An artistic form of nonverbal communication

rows.label: RHYME ROYAL
rows.clue: A stanza form having seven lines of iambic pentameter

rows.label: JABBER
rows.clue: Rapid and indistinct speech

rows.label: NOTATION
rows.clue: A technical system of symbols used to represent special things

rows.label: BINARY CODE
rows.clue: Code using a string of 8 binary digits to represent characters

rows.label: CROSSFIRE
rows.clue: A lively or heated interchange of ideas and opinions

rows.label: SUBTITLE
rows.clue: Translation of foreign dialogue of a movie or TV program

rows.label: BLUE PETER
rows.clue: A blue flag with a white square in the center indicates that the vessel is ready to sail

rows.label: DIMINUTIVE
rows.clue: A word that is formed with a suffix (such as -let or -kin) to indicate smallness

rows.label: FILM CLIP
rows.clue: A strip of motion picture film used in a telecast

rows.label: RUBRIC
rows.clue: An authoritative rule of conduct or procedure

rows.label: COLOR CODE
rows.clue: System using colors to designate classifications

rows.label: ENCYCLICAL
rows.clue: A letter from the pope sent to all Roman Catholic bishops throughout the world

rows.label: RAP SESSION
rows.clue: Conversation in a situation where feelings can be expressed and criticized or supported

rows.label: ASKING
rows.clue: The verbal act of requesting

rows.label: RECAP
rows.clue: A summary at the end that repeats the substance of a longer discussion

rows.label: THRILLER
rows.clue: A suspenseful adventure story or play or movie

rows.label: TITLE BAR
rows.clue: (computer science) a horizontal label at the top of a window, bearing the name of the currently active document

rows.label: POSTMORTEM
rows.clue: Discussion of an event after it has occurred

rows.label: RAIN CHECK
rows.clue: A promise that an unaccepted offer will be renewed in the future

rows.label: GRIMACE
rows.clue: A contorted facial expression

rows.label: DRAWL
rows.clue: A slow speech pattern with prolonged vowels

rows.label: BLOCK LETTER
rows.clue: A plain hand-drawn letter

rows.label: SHOWDOWN
rows.clue: A hostile disagreement face-to-face

rows.label: HAIR STROKE
rows.clue: A very fine line in writing or printing

rows.label: EXCERPT
rows.clue: A passage selected from a larger work

rows.label: DRAFT COPY
rows.clue: Any of the various versions in the development of a written work

rows.label: CHAT
rows.clue: An informal conversation

rows.label: POTBOILER
rows.clue: A literary composition of poor quality that was written quickly to make money (to boil the pot)

rows.label: CONCERTO
rows.clue: A composition for orchestra and a soloist

rows.label: ALLUSION
rows.clue: Passing reference or indirect mention

rows.label: VOCATIVE
rows.clue: The case (in some inflected languages) used when the referent of the noun is being addressed

rows.label: TEAR SHEET
rows.clue: A sheet that can be easily torn out of a publication

rows.label: MAJOR SCALE
rows.clue: A diatonic scale with notes separated by whole tones except for the 3rd and 4th and 7th and 8th

rows.label: FLASHBACK
rows.clue: A transition (in literary or theatrical works or films) to an earlier event or scene that interrupts the normal chronological development of the story

rows.label: MASS MEDIUM
rows.clue: (usually plural) transmissions that are disseminated widely to the public

rows.label: SKYWRITING
rows.clue: Writing formed in the sky by smoke released from an airplane

rows.label: INSIGNIA
rows.clue: A badge worn to show official position

rows.label: GREEN PAPER
rows.clue: A preliminary report of government proposals that is published in order to stimulate discussion

rows.label: SUBORNATION
rows.clue: Underhandedly or improperly inducing someone to do something improper or unlawful

rows.label: TURN SIGNAL
rows.clue: A blinking light on a motor vehicle that indicates the direction in which the vehicle is about to turn

rows.label: PEDAL
rows.clue: A sustained bass note

rows.label: CERTIFICATE
rows.clue: A document attesting to the truth of certain stated facts

rows.label: TELEGRAPHY
rows.clue: Communicating at a distance by electric transmission over wire

rows.label: INFOMERCIAL
rows.clue: A television commercial presented in the form of a short documentary

rows.label: VOICE PART
rows.clue: A part written for a singer

rows.label: POSTMARK
rows.clue: A cancellation mark stamped on mail by postal officials

rows.label: CHANNEL
rows.clue: A path over which electrical signals can pass

rows.label: WARNING
rows.clue: A message informing of danger

rows.label: HYPERBOLE
rows.clue: Extravagant exaggeration

rows.label: CLASS LIST
rows.clue: A list issued by examiners that categorizes students according to the class of honours they achieved in their degree examinations

rows.label: DROLLERY
rows.clue: A comic incident or series of incidents

rows.label: PROPOSITION
rows.clue: (logic) a statement that affirms or denies something and is either true or false

rows.label: CAPTION
rows.clue: Taking exception

rows.label: VOCAL
rows.clue: Music intended to be performed by one or more singers, usually with instrumental accompaniment

rows.label: EXPLICATION
rows.clue: The act of making clear or removing obscurity from the meaning of a word or symbol or expression etc.

rows.label: CHANNELS
rows.clue: Official routes of communication

rows.label: IDEOGRAM
rows.clue: A graphic character that indicates the meaning of a thing without indicating the sounds used to say it

rows.label: HOOF MARK
rows.clue: A visible impression on a surface made by the hoof of an animal

rows.label: TICKET STUB
rows.clue: A torn part of a ticket returned to the holder as a receipt

rows.label: DOUBLE RHYME
rows.clue: A two-syllable rhyme

rows.label: ENJOINING
rows.clue: (law) a judicial remedy issued in order to prohibit a party from doing or continuing to do a certain activity

rows.label: COMIC OPERA
rows.clue: Opera with a happy ending and in which some of the text is spoken

rows.label: PHONE NUMBER
rows.clue: The number is used in calling a particular telephone

rows.label: TABULATION
rows.clue: Information set out in tabular form

rows.label: LIGATURE
rows.clue: (music) a group of notes connected by a slur

rows.label: DETRACTION
rows.clue: A petty disparagement

rows.label: TRANSCRIPT
rows.clue: Something that has been transcribed

rows.label: SCORECARD
rows.clue: (golf) a record of scores (as in golf)

rows.label: FINGERBOARD
rows.clue: A guidepost resembling a hand with a pointing index finger

rows.label: EULOGY
rows.clue: A formal expression of praise for someone who has died recently

rows.label: REPUDIATION
rows.clue: Rejecting or disowning or disclaiming as invalid

rows.label: UNCTION
rows.clue: Excessive but superficial compliments given with affected charm

rows.label: NIGHT LETTER
rows.clue: A cheaper form of telegram sent for delivery the next day

rows.label: NAME
rows.clue: A language unit by which a person or thing is known

rows.label: INDENT
rows.clue: An order for goods to be exported or imported

rows.label: GENERIC NOUN
rows.clue: A noun that does not specify either masculine or feminine gender

rows.label: VIGNETTE
rows.clue: A brief literary description

rows.label: REDUNDANCY
rows.clue: Repetition of messages to reduce the probability of errors in transmission

rows.label: BLANK VERSE
rows.clue: Unrhymed verse (usually in iambic pentameter)

rows.label: FINAL EXAM
rows.clue: An examination administered at the end of an academic term

rows.label: RUNNING HEAD
rows.clue: A heading printed at the top of every page (or every other page) of a book

rows.label: MONOLOGUE
rows.clue: Speech you make to yourself

rows.label: LEGALESE
rows.clue: A style that uses the abstruse technical vocabulary of the law

rows.label: PALINDROME
rows.clue: A word or phrase that reads the same backward as forward

rows.label: GAMMA
rows.clue: The 3rd letter of the Greek alphabet

rows.label: TECHNO
rows.clue: A style of fast heavy electronic dance music usually without vocals

rows.label: CALL WAITING
rows.clue: A way of letting you know that someone else is calling when you are using your telephone

rows.label: REGULATION
rows.clue: An authoritative rule

rows.label: PET NAME
rows.clue: A name of endearment (especially one using a diminutive suffix)

rows.label: LITHOGRAPHY
rows.clue: A method of planographic printing from a metal or stone surface

rows.label: CLOSET DRAMA
rows.clue: Drama more suitable for reading that for performing
